The campaign is live: $300 total, $60 a day, Bangkok-time schedule, iOS only, with all three posts. I'll check it on the schedule so I can review it across the five days.

The first day is on pace: about $40.00 spent by 17:00 Bangkok time, against a $60 daily pace. The third post (2152452326815646911) has the best click-through so far, at about 0.16% versus about 0.06–0.08% for the other two. The sample is small, so I'll keep all three running for now. I'll check again tomorrow.

Spend is tracking the $60 daily pace: about $99 since launch. Post 2152452326815646911 has the highest click-through rate, but all three cost about the same per link click, so I'll leave the split as is for now. Next check is Friday.

Through Friday morning (Bangkok time), spend is about $158.62 of the $300 budget, on pace for the $60 daily cap. Click costs are almost identical across the three posts, about $0.38 each, so there's no basis yet for shifting spend. Budget runs out near the end of Sunday at this rate, so I'll check that the total doesn't exhaust early.

Through Saturday morning (Bangkok time), spend is $221.50, with about $78 left under the $300 cap. That's enough to run most of Sunday at the $60 pace, so I expect the budget to run out late Sunday. Click costs are still nearly identical across the three posts (about $0.37 each), so I'll keep the split as it is. I'll check again after the flight ends.
